entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the Mountain Bike Shoes. To make sure I'm handling this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They don't work. I went for one ride and got blisters.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Just to cover all bases, did you have a chance to adjust the placement of the cleats or try a different type of cycling sock? Sometimes a small adjustment can make a world of difference in fit.
I've been cycling for ten years. I know how to set up my shoes. I just want a refund.

Of course, I understand completely. Let me confirm the delivery date... it looks like they arrived just six days ago. Our cycling shoes have a 90-day return policy, so you are well within the window. I can absolutely get that return started for you.
Fine. So what do I do?

I'm sending an email to the address on file right now. It will contain a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive them, we'll process your full refund.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.
You certainly will. The email has been sent. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find a better-fitting shoe for you in the future. Have a good day.
